subject: en_guided
source: English National Curriculum — English programmes of study: key stage 1 (Year 2 reading comprehension), taught through VIPERS guided reading skills (vocabulary, infer, predict, explain, retrieve, sequence)

weeks.topic: Guided reading routines: VIPERS question stems
objectives: Learn what each VIPERS letter means
Use question stems to talk about a text

weeks.topic: Retrieve: skimming to find key words
objectives: Skim a page to find a key word
Use the key word to answer a question

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: working out words from context
objectives: Use the words around a new word to guess its meaning
Check the meaning in a dictionary

weeks.topic: Predict: using evidence from the text
objectives: Make a prediction based on what has happened
Support it with evidence

weeks.topic: Sequence: main events in a chapter
objectives: Identify the main events in a chapter
Put them in order

weeks.topic: Infer: feelings from dialogue
objectives: Work out how characters feel from what they say
Read dialogue with expression

weeks.topic: Explain: why the author chose the title
objectives: Discuss what the title tells the reader
Suggest a different title and explain why

weeks.topic: Retrieve: answering in full sentences
objectives: Answer retrieval questions in full sentences
Use words from the question in my answer

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: favourite words and phrases
objectives: Choose effective words and phrases
Explain why the author chose them

weeks.topic: Infer: why characters act as they do
objectives: Discuss characters' motives
Use clues from the text

weeks.topic: Explain: how non-fiction is organised
objectives: Explain the purpose of headings, captions and contents
Compare two non-fiction layouts

weeks.topic: Sequence: retelling with time words
objectives: Retell events using time words
Keep events in the right order

weeks.topic: Predict: the next chapter
objectives: Predict what will happen in the next chapter
Check my prediction after reading

weeks.topic: Retrieve: tables, labels and fact boxes
objectives: Find information in tables and fact boxes
Answer questions using the data

weeks.topic: Review: VIPERS skills from Term 1
objectives: Practise retrieval, inference and prediction
Answer mixed questions on a short text

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: definitions and glossaries
objectives: Match words to their definitions
Use a glossary to check meanings

weeks.topic: Infer: settings and atmosphere
objectives: Work out the mood of a setting
Find words that create the atmosphere

weeks.topic: Explain: the author's message in a fable
objectives: Explain the lesson of a fable
Say if I agree with it

weeks.topic: Retrieve: answers in poems
objectives: Find information in a poem
Quote a line to support my answer

weeks.topic: Sequence: summarising a short text
objectives: Summarise a short text in a few sentences
Include only the important events

weeks.topic: Predict: comparing predictions with what happened
objectives: Compare my prediction with the events
Explain what clues I used

weeks.topic: Infer: I think … because …
objectives: Give an inference with evidence
Use the sentence stem I think … because …

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: prefixes and suffixes in context
objectives: Work out word meanings using prefixes and suffixes
Read words with un-, -ful and -less

weeks.topic: Explain: comparing two versions of a story
objectives: Compare characters and events in two versions
Say which version I prefer and why

weeks.topic: Retrieve: true or false from an information text
objectives: Decide if statements are true or false
Find the evidence in the text

weeks.topic: Sequence: steps in instructions and explanations
objectives: Order steps in instructions
Explain why order matters

weeks.topic: Mid-year guided reading assessment
objectives: Answer retrieval, vocabulary and inference questions
Explain answers using the text

weeks.topic: Infer: relationships between characters
objectives: Work out how characters feel about each other
Use evidence from words and actions

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: recurring language in stories and poems
objectives: Spot repeated phrases in stories and poems
Discuss why authors repeat them

weeks.topic: Predict: from a blurb
objectives: Read a blurb and predict the story
Decide if I want to read the book

weeks.topic: Explain: does it make sense? Clarifying meaning
objectives: Check that the text makes sense as I read
Re-read and correct inaccurate reading

weeks.topic: Retrieve: who, what, where, when and how
objectives: Answer the five question words quickly
Find evidence for each answer

weeks.topic: Sequence: a chapter in one sentence
objectives: Summarise a chapter in one sentence
Choose the most important event

weeks.topic: Explain: justifying opinions about a character
objectives: Give an opinion about a character
Justify it with evidence

weeks.topic: Mixed VIPERS practice with a short story
objectives: Answer a mix of VIPERS questions
Check answers against the text

weeks.topic: End-of-year guided reading assessment
objectives: Read an unseen text and answer mixed questions
Use evidence in my answers

weeks.topic: Year 2 review: ready for Year 3 reading
objectives: Reflect on the VIPERS skills I am best at
Set a reading target for Year 3
